svg.aria-label: Action Toggle dimensional drawing: source dimensions, dual Morph grids, persistent value, feedback and sizing modes
svg.text: WRAPPED SLOTS KEEP EQUAL SIDE PADDING.
HIDDEN SIZERS RESERVE EACH SLOT SEPARATELY.
RESET CLEARS FEEDBACK, NOT PRESSED STATE.
SUCCESS SHOWS RESTING PRESSED CONTENT; NO EXTRA SUCCESS GLYPH.
WIDEST: MAX GLYPH + S2 + MAX LABEL
ACTION TOGGLE · PERSISTENT VALUE + ASYNC FEEDBACK
